chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ali ibn Ibrahim al-Ja'fari, from one of his companions, raising it, said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: The scent of the oud (agarwood) which is in the body remains for forty days, and the scent of the oud of the perfumed cloth remains for twenty days.
ai.seo_question: How long does the scent of oud remain in the body after death according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) specifies that the scent of agarwood remains in the body for forty days, while the scent of the perfumed burial shroud (murtat) lasts for twenty days, reflecting the distinct spiritual and physical states of the deceased. This distinction highlights the significance of the shroud in Islamic burial rites and is frequently referenced in fiqh discussions concerning the duration of the soul's attachment to the body and the validity of burial practices.
